notes.title: New battle mode. New map.
notes.content:
New battle mode. New map. Defeat the opposing team on a map with a shrinking circle.
No crafting, find yourself a weapon and immediately join the battle.

Update 1.0.2.0 includes the following improvements:
[list]
[*] New map.
[*] Battle mode with a shrinking circle.
[*] New houses.
[*] Changed raid system.
[*] UI improvements.
[*] Lots of other small improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: New classic survival mode. Build your own castle solo or with friends!
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1.3 includes the following improvements:

- New classic survival mode. Build your own castle solo or with friends.
To create your own team, approach your friend, press F and then your friend will be able to accept the invitation by opening the inventory menu.
- Decay system. Add some stone to the main keep to keep the castle from decaying.
- Now there are no time limits for modifying the castle. Destroy any objects at any time.
- Both regular chests and private chests are now available to you.
- The character is now wearing pants by default.
- New placeable - stairs.
- New placeable - main keep.
- As well as many other improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Minor update 1.0.1.2
notes.content:
Small fixes:
[list]
[*] When crafting with a full inventory, the new item will drop to the ground.
[*] Some melee combat fixes.
[*] Fixed a bug where the sound of footsteps looped after the death of the character.
[*] Throwing animation fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: New map, weapons, placeables and buildings! Try The Demo Now!
notes.content:
Hi all! Update 1.0.1.0 has been released, adding the following changes to the game:

- Lots of new weapons:  espadon, grossmessser, claymore, zweihander, flamberge, bardiche, poleaxe, halberd, glaive, billhook, partisan, lance and etc.
- New map with houses and tents full of loot.
- Hunger system.
- Possibility to cook bread, meat, cheese with the help of new placeable items.
- Hunting system.
- The character can now sprint.
- Equipping animation.
- Use a buckler for two-handed weapons and a shield for one-handed weapons.
- New towers to build.
